lookback_summary: Well, what a weekend it was! The model had a decent outing, correctly calling the draw in the Fulham vs Man United match, and it also nailed the wins for Man City and Newcastle, both of which had strong home performances. But I had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs Crystal Palace game, where the model faded the home win but it ended up as a draw – talk about a swing and a miss! Not to mention Brighton's shocking display against Arsenal, which none of us saw coming, and the model was wrong about Tottenham too. Overall, a mixed bag but a few bright spots for the model to take away.
